proof_scope: Live $memory persona_memory recall creates source-bound emotional triggers for Persona Dream consolidation.

claims.proves: A natural-language persona-scoped live $memory recall can select emotional experience records, exactly reread their source documents, and create hash-bound Persona Dream emotional triggers.
claims.does_not_prove: That a trigger was accepted as a personality delta, changed future behavior, or was perceived by a human listener.

capability_claims.description: Persona Dream creates emotional triggers from live persona_memory recall with exact source reread and hash lineage.

cases.name: live-persona-memory-recall-creates-emotional-triggers
cases.description: Recalls Embry experience through live $memory, exactly rereads selected persona_memory documents, and emits source-bound emotional triggers.
command:
D=/tmp/persona-dream-agentic-memory-trigger; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh recall-emotional-triggers --persona embry --query 'What remembered experiences carry the strongest emotion for Embry Lawson and could shape how she responds in a later conversation?' --output "$D/emotional_context.json" --receipt "$D/receipt.json" --json >/dev/null && python - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('/tmp/persona-dream-agentic-memory-trigger/receipt.json'))
p=json.load(open('/tmp/persona-dream-agentic-memory-trigger/emotional_context.json'))
assert r['status']=='PASS_MEMORY_RECALL_EMOTIONAL_TRIGGERS', r
assert r['live'] is True and r['mocked'] is False, r
assert r['collection']=='persona_memory' and r['persona_tag']=='persona:embry', r
assert r['trigger_count'] > 0 and all(x['exact_reread'] for x in r['source_rows']), r
assert all(t['provenance']['source_collection']=='persona_memory' for t in p['triggers']), p
assert all(t['appraisal']['emotions'] and t['appraisal']['intensity'] is not None for t in p['triggers']), p
print('PASS_LIVE_MEMORY_RECALL_EMOTIONAL_TRIGGERS')
PY

cases.name: reject-non-question-persona-memory-trigger-query
cases.description: Rejects a keyword pile before memory recall because persona-memory proof queries must be natural-language questions.
command: set +e; out=$(bash ../run.sh recall-emotional-triggers --persona embry --query 'Embry emotional strongest memories' --output /tmp/should-not-exist-trigger.json --receipt /tmp/should-not-exist-trigger-receipt.json --json 2>&1); rc=$?; set -e; test "$rc" -ne 0; printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'BLOCKED_TRIGGER_RECALL_QUERY_NOT_QUESTION_SHAPED'; echo PASS_NON_QUESTION_TRIGGER_RECALL_REJECTED

cases.name: derived-trigger-cannot-reenter-as-source-experience
cases.description: Deterministic fail-closed gate: a persisted Persona Dream emotional_trigger record (even with stronger lexical relevance) must be rejected by source admissibility while the literal experience is admitted; admitted triggers carry source_is_derived false and a non-empty source_event_identity.
command:
uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ret', '../scripts/recall_emotional_triggers.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
E1 = {'_key': 'embry_literal_experience_001', 'schema': 'memory.record.v1', 'record_type': 'experience', 'persona_id': 'embry', 'user_id': 'graham', 'observed_at': '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z', 'tags': ['persona:embry', 'user:graham'], 'summary': 'Embry recalled losing the regional finals while graham watched from the sideline.', 'event_context': {'immediate_trigger': 'losing the regional finals while graham watched'}, 'emotional_context': {'emotions': ['sadness', 'resolve'], 'intensity': 4, 'emotional_valence': 'negative'}}
D1 = {'_key': 'persona_dream_emotional_trigger_x_t1', 'schema': 'persona_dream.emotional_trigger.v1', 'record_type': 'emotional_trigger', 'kind': 'persona_dream_emotional_trigger', 'project': 'persona-dream', 'persona_id': 'embry', 'user_id': 'graham', 'tags': ['persona-dream', 'emotional-trigger', 'persona:embry', 'user:graham'], 'trigger_text': 'strongest emotion Embry regional finals sadness', 'empathy': {'confidence': 0.0}}
ok, reason = m._source_admissibility(D1, persona='embry', user='graham')
assert ok is False and reason, (ok, reason)
ok2, reason2 = m._source_admissibility(E1, persona='embry', user='graham')
assert ok2 is True, (ok2, reason2)
assert m._source_admissibility(E1, persona='embry', user=None)[0] is True
assert m._source_admissibility(E1, persona='horus', user=None)[0] is False
# case-insensitive discriminators cannot slip past the gate
D1_lower = dict(D1); D1_lower['record_type'] = 'EMOTIONAL_TRIGGER'; D1_lower['kind'] = 'Persona_Dream_Emotional_Trigger'; D1_lower['tags'] = ['Persona-Dream', 'Emotional-Trigger', 'persona:embry']
ok3, reason3 = m._source_admissibility(D1_lower, persona='embry', user='graham')
assert ok3 is False and reason3, (ok3, reason3)
# ambiguous relationship identity fails closed
E_amb = dict(E1); E_amb['user_id'] = 'graham'; E_amb['tags'] = ['persona:embry', 'user:graham', 'user:alice']
assert m._source_user(E_amb) == '', E_amb
trigger = m._trigger(E1, query='Why does this experience still carry emotion?', recall_rank=1, recall_sha='sha256:test')
assert trigger, 'literal experience must emit a trigger'
assert trigger.get('source_is_derived') is False, trigger
assert trigger.get('source_event_identity'), trigger
assert trigger.get('source_event_identity_class') == 'document_fallback', trigger
E1c = dict(E1); E1c['event_id'] = 'evt-regional-finals-2026'
trigger_c = m._trigger(E1c, query='Why does this experience still carry emotion?', recall_rank=1, recall_sha='sha256:test')
assert trigger_c.get('source_event_identity') == 'evt-regional-finals-2026' and trigger_c.get('source_event_identity_class') == 'canonical', trigger_c
assert trigger.get('recency_known') is True, trigger
assert trigger.get('source_user_id') == 'graham', trigger
print('PASS_DERIVED_TRIGGER_CANNOT_REENTER')
PY

cases.name: relationship-unproven-blocks-persist
cases.description: Deterministic fail-closed gate: persisting a trigger whose source carries no user identity with --user graham must exit nonzero with BLOCKED_TRIGGER_RELATIONSHIP_UNPROVEN and write nothing.
command:
uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import argparse, importlib.util, json, pathlib, tempfile
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('petm', '../scripts/persist_emotional_trigger_memory.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ctx = pathlib.Path(d) / 'emotional_context.json'
trigger = {'trigger_id': 't1', 'trigger_text': 'A remembered loss still carries sadness.', 'source_event_ids': ['persona_memory/embry_literal_experience_001'], 'source_types': ['persona_memory_recall'], 'appraisal': {'emotions': ['sadness'], 'intensity': 0.8}, 'provenance': {'source_collection': 'persona_memory', 'source_key': 'embry_literal_experience_001', 'source_document_sha256': 'sha256:abc'}}
ctx.write_text(json.dumps({'triggers': [trigger]}))
ns = argparse.Namespace(run_dir=pathlib.Path(d), context=ctx, output=None, persona='embry', user='graham', run_id='red-test', memory_base_url='http://127.0.0.1:9')
try:
    m.run(ns)
except SystemExit as e:
    assert 'BLOCKED_TRIGGER_RELATIONSHIP_UNPROVEN' in str(e), e
    print('PASS_RELATIONSHIP_UNPROVEN_BLOCKED')
    raise SystemExit(0)
raise SystemExit('FAIL: relationship-unproven persistence was not blocked')
PY

cases.name: identity-fields-survive-persist-reread
cases.description: Live roundtrip: recall real source-bound triggers, persist them, and prove every identity/provenance field (source_event_identity, identity class, record type/kind, source relationship, timestamps, recency, derived flag) survives the exact reread unchanged. Live Embry memory docs carry no user tags, so the relationship is proven as the empty-string value these sources actually have (a non-empty relationship is exercised by the reverify negatives).
command:
D=/tmp/pd-identity-roundtrip; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh recall-emotional-triggers --persona embry --query 'What remembered experiences carry the strongest emotion for Embry Lawson and could shape how she responds in a later conversation?' --output "$D/ec.json" --receipt "$D/recall.json" --json >/dev/null && uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
D = Path('/tmp/pd-identity-roundtrip')
ctx = json.load(open(D / 'ec.json'))
trigs = [t for t in ctx.get('triggers', []) if isinstance(t, dict)]
assert trigs, 'no triggers recalled'
user = str(trigs[0].get('source_user_id') or '')
sel = trigs
ctx['triggers'] = sel
(D / 'filtered.json').write_text(json.dumps(ctx))
rid = f"identity-roundtrip-{os.getpid()}"
r = subprocess.run(['bash', '../run.sh', 'persist-emotional-triggers', '--context', str(D / 'filtered.json'), '--user', user, '--run-id', rid, '--output', str(D / 'persist.json'), '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'persist failed rc={r.returncode}: {r.stderr[-400:]}'
pr = json.load(open(D / 'persist.json'))
assert pr['status'] == 'PASS_EMOTIONAL_TRIGGER_MEMORY_REREAD', pr
fields = ['source_event_identity','source_event_identity_class','source_record_type','source_kind','source_user_id','source_observed_at','source_event_at','recency_known','source_is_derived']
missing = [f for f in fields if f not in pr.get('exact_fields', [])]
assert not missing, f'exact_fields missing {missing}'
assert len(pr['memory_keys']) == len(sel) and all(x['exact_reread'] for x in pr['exact_rereads']), pr['exact_rereads']
with httpx.Client(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:8601', timeout=15) as c:
    for key, trig in zip(pr['memory_keys'], sel):
        docs = c.post('/list', json={'collection': 'persona_memory', 'limit': 2, 'filters': {'_key': key}}).json().get('documents') or []
        assert len(docs) == 1, (key, len(docs))
        got = docs[0]
        for f in fields:
            expect = bool(trig.get(f)) if f in ('recency_known', 'source_is_derived') else str(trig.get(f) or '')
            assert got.get(f) == expect, (key, f, got.get(f), expect)
print('PASS_IDENTITY_ROUNDTRIP')
PY
expected_notes: receipt exact_fields covers all nine identity/provenance fields
independent /list reread equals the trigger packet value for every field

cases.name: source-reverify-forged-hash-blocked
cases.description: Live negative: a trigger packet whose declared source_document_sha256 disagrees with the exact $memory source reread is blocked by the persistence reverify gate with zero writes.
command:
D=/tmp/pd-reverify-hash; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh recall-emotional-triggers --persona embry --query 'What remembered experiences carry the strongest emotion for Embry Lawson and could shape how she responds in a later conversation?' --output "$D/ec.json" --receipt "$D/recall.json" --json >/dev/null && uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pmod', '../scripts/persist_emotional_trigger_memory.py')
pmod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(pmod)
D = Path('/tmp/pd-reverify-hash')
ctx = json.load(open(D / 'ec.json'))
trigs = [t for t in ctx.get('triggers', []) if isinstance(t, dict)]
assert trigs, 'no triggers recalled'
t = trigs[0]
t['provenance']['source_document_sha256'] = str(t['provenance'].get('source_document_sha256') or '') + 'x'
ctx['triggers'] = [t]
(D / 'forged.json').write_text(json.dumps(ctx))
rid = f"reverify-hash-{os.getpid()}"
r = subprocess.run(['bash', '../run.sh', 'persist-emotional-triggers', '--context', str(D / 'forged.json'), '--user', str(t.get('source_user_id') or ''), '--run-id', rid, '--output', str(D / 'persist.json'), '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode != 0, f'forged hash was accepted: {r.stdout[-300:]}'
blob = r.stdout + r.stderr
assert 'BLOCKED_TRIGGER_SOURCE_REVERIFY_FAILED' in blob, blob[-400:]
would_be_key = f"persona_dream_emotional_trigger_{pmod._slug(rid)}_{pmod._slug(t['trigger_id'])}"
with httpx.Client(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:8601', timeout=15) as c:
    docs = c.post('/list', json={'collection': 'persona_memory', 'limit': 2, 'filters': {'_key': would_be_key}}).json().get('documents') or []
assert len(docs) == 0, f'forged packet wrote anyway: {len(docs)} docs at {would_be_key}'
print('PASS_REVERIFY_FORGED_HASH')
PY
expected_notes: zero-write proof: /list by the would-be _key returns no document

cases.name: source-reverify-forged-relationship-blocked
cases.description: Live negative: a packet whose source_user_id forges a relationship that --user confirms passes the request filter but is rejected by source reverify (packet claims disagree with the reread source document), with zero writes.
command:
D=/tmp/pd-reverify-rel; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; bash ../run.sh recall-emotional-triggers --persona embry --query 'What remembered experiences carry the strongest emotion for Embry Lawson and could shape how she responds in a later conversation?' --output "$D/ec.json" --receipt "$D/recall.json" --json >/dev/null && uv run --project .. python - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pmod', '../scripts/persist_emotional_trigger_memory.py')
pmod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(pmod)
D = Path('/tmp/pd-reverify-rel')
ctx = json.load(open(D / 'ec.json'))
trigs = [t for t in ctx.get('triggers', []) if isinstance(t, dict)]
assert trigs, 'no triggers recalled'
t = trigs[0]
forged = 'pd-forged-user-xyz'
t['source_user_id'] = forged
ctx['triggers'] = [t]
(D / 'forged.json').write_text(json.dumps(ctx))
rid = f"reverify-rel-{os.getpid()}"
r = subprocess.run(['bash', '../run.sh', 'persist-emotional-triggers', '--context', str(D / 'forged.json'), '--user', forged, '--run-id', rid, '--output', str(D / 'persist.json'), '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode != 0, f'forged relationship was accepted: {r.stdout[-300:]}'
blob = r.stdout + r.stderr
assert ('BLOCKED_TRIGGER_SOURCE_REVERIFY_FAILED' in blob) or ('BLOCKED_TRIGGER_RELATIONSHIP_MISMATCH' in blob), blob[-400:]
would_be_key = f"persona_dream_emotional_trigger_{pmod._slug(rid)}_{pmod._slug(t['trigger_id'])}"
with httpx.Client(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:8601', timeout=15) as c:
    docs = c.post('/list', json={'collection': 'persona_memory', 'limit': 2, 'filters': {'_key': would_be_key}}).json().get('documents') or []
assert len(docs) == 0, f'forged packet wrote anyway: {len(docs)} docs at {would_be_key}'
print('PASS_REVERIFY_FORGED_RELATIONSHIP')
PY
expected_notes: --user equal to the forged source_user_id passes the request filter, so the block must come from the source reread
persist exits nonzero naming BLOCKED_TRIGGER_SOURCE_REVERIFY_FAILED (or BLOCKED_TRIGGER_RELATIONSHIP_MISMATCH if caught earlier)
zero-write proof: /list by the would-be _key returns no document
